## Historical Task Snapshot
None.

## Goal
To maintain a consolidated record of configuration values, operational constraints, and team-specific settings for projects (Orion, Bramble, Falcon, Vesper, Fjord, Ember, Alder), hosts (Vega, Indigo, Kestrel, Prism, Wren, Comet, Solstice, Jasper, Maple, Thistle, Sierra, Dune, Basalt), infrastructure components (Harbor, License Server, Pulsar DB, Grafana), and services as discussed between 2026-01-05 and 2026-03-26.

## Constraints & Preferences
- **Linting Policy**: Use `ruff` for linting Python code in all repos.
- **Deployment Protocol**: Before pushing any branch, the command `make test` must be executed on the Vega host. Avoid force-pushing to shared branches.
- **Code Review SLA**: 
    - Orion team adheres to a code review Service Level Agreement (SLA) of 15 hours.
    - Fjord team adheres to a code review Service Level Agreement (SLA) of 7 hours, except for the intern cohort which uses 72 hours.
    - Thistle team adheres to a code review Service Level Agreement (SLA) of 70 hours, with an exception for Fridays where it is 42 hours.
    - Umbra team adheres to a code review Service Level Agreement (SLA) of 56 hours.
- **Build/Cache Management**: 
    - Bramble team operates with a build cache size of 1527 GB.
    - Harbor build cache size is 1933 GB, except for the frontend squad which uses 2439 GB.
    - Fjord build cache size is 2521 GB (updated from 1231 GB).
    - Umbra uses 2933 GB as its standard build cache size; exception for the intern cohort which uses 182 GB.
- **Stand-up Times**: 
    - Orion team stand-up time was initially noted as 16:10, subsequently updated to 12:50 on 2026-01-10.
    - Bramble team stand-up delta time is recorded as 18:25.
    - Falcon stand-up time is set to 21:25; Frontend squad of Falcon overrides this with 22:05.
    - Vesper uses 19:40 as its stand-up time (updated from 16:55), except for the frontend squad which overrides with 17:20.
    - Harbor stand-up time is 14:25, except for the intern cohort where it is 22:40.
    - Comet stand-up time is 23:25.
    - Thistle stand-up time is set to 13:05 (updated from 15:50 on 2026-03-21).
- **Test Coverage Thresholds**: 
    - Orion's minimum test coverage threshold is strictly maintained at 91%. A proposal to raise this to 94% was explicitly rejected on 2026-01-09. Note: The intern cohort of Orion overrides the coverage gate with 90%.
    - Bramble's test coverage threshold is set at 87% (updated from 48%).
    - Vesper test coverage threshold is 44%.
- **Flaky Test Handling**: Integration tests that exhibit flakiness are managed with a retry delay of 4829 ms to ensure reliable passing.
- **Code Style**: 
    - Harbor enforces a maximum line length of 105 characters (proposal to change to 113 chars was rejected).
    - Falcon enforces a line-length limit of 240 chars.
    - Bramble uses 133 chars as its max line length (proposal to move to 104 chars was rejected).
    - Fjord uses 83 chars as its max line length (updated from 75 chars on 2026-03-11; proposal to change to 203 chars was rejected on 2026-03-13).
    - Umbra uses 120 chars as its max line length, except on Fridays where it is 163 chars.
    - Thistle uses 82 chars as its max line length (updated from 187 chars on 2026-03-09).
    - Comet uses 93 chars as its max line length (updated from 213 chars on 2026-02-18; exception for frontend squad at 185 chars).
- **Deployment Branch**: Ember deploy branch is set to `release-693` (updated from `release-499`). Solstice config has deploy branch `release-764` (updated from `release-281`). Alder deploy branch is set to `release-698` (updated from `release-655`; batch jobs override with `release-636`).
